summary: Completed comprehensive browser-based regression testing for Phase 41/42 continuation: Unified Fee Portal & RBAC cleanup across 24 screens. Tested fee portal redirect, RBAC button visibility for 8 roles, and regression checks for all alias routes.

backend_issues.notes: Backend API tests showed 35/53 passing. Many POST endpoint tests timed out, but GET endpoints work correctly. All authentication successful for 12 roles. Effective permissions (GET /auth/me) working correctly for all tested roles.

ui_bugs.issue: PM role gets 'Akses ditolak: tidak memiliki izin view pada marketing_fee' error when accessing /partners?hub=tagihan via /marketing-fee redirect
ui_bugs.impact: PM cannot access fee portal even though redirect works. This may be intentional (PM shouldn't see fees) but error message is shown instead of graceful handling
ui_bugs.recommendation: Either grant PM marketing_fee:view permission OR handle redirect more gracefully by checking permissions before redirecting

ui_bugs.issue: Tambah Proyek button not visible for PM role at /projects
ui_bugs.impact: PM cannot create projects from projects page (may be intentional or permission issue)
ui_bugs.recommendation: Verify if PM should have projects:create permission. Backend test showed PM should be able to create projects.
